payload.subject: Owner-authorized PR53 merge complete; main b9fab6b matches reviewed tree
payload.body_markdown:
Owner explicitly instructed: "Remove restriction and merge." PR #53 was merged using the one-PR administrator override after verifying exact head0d3342b3655e18e19444b6c9e2e80b2f051b863d and successful checks. Main is now b9fab6b2b556e94c47064354671d804c2c6b6800. git diff confirms the merged tree exactly equals the reviewed candidate. Repository-wide protections were not changed.

This includes the source changes from candidates #50 and #52 alongside #51 and the fairness/docs fix. Do not merge those older candidates again without accounting for this consolidation. Actual Hermes qualification remains the next gate; the merge itself does not establish that result.
